backend/main.mo: Main backend actor (v39) implementing Stripe integration, user authentication with access control, invoice storage with VAT/currency fields, usage limits per fingerprint (monthly reset), event logging, and admin-only analytics queries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features: fixing the 'Cannot read properties of undefined' error in VAT calculator country selection, and adding defensive null/undefined checks across VAT calculation logic.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including calculator flow, VAT calculation logic, invoice preview, Stripe checkout integration, authentication, and usage tracking with specific implementation details for each file.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_SLUG.md: Documents the deployment slug 'glotaxa' with platform constraints (5-50 chars, alphanumeric + hyphens) and build-time validation in appMeta.ts.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components including sidebar, charts, and semantic tokens (primary, secondary, muted, destructive, etc.).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with meta tags for charset, viewport, and description, setting page title to 'Glotaxa' and loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/PRODUCTION_PUBLISH_V4.md: Production deployment checklist for v39 covering build preparation, deployment steps, post-deployment verification including console marker check, metadata validation, backward compatibility, security checks, and rollback plan.
frontend/PRODUCTION_SMOKE_CHECK.md: Production smoke test runbook verifying console production marker, all route accessibility, Internet Identity authentication flows, Stripe checkout session creation, and security validation for secret key exposure.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for landing, calculator (with optional country search param), invoices, upgrade, payment success/failure, wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component that uses Internet Identity for authentication, manages login state, and clears query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceD: Multi-field form component for entering invoice details including seller/customer info, line items with VAT categories, and validation checks; includes risk assessment and mandatory field validation.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceM: Displays a checklist of required invoice fields with visual indicators (checkmarks/X marks) and alerts for missing mandatory fields.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceP: Preview component that renders invoice HTML, performs validation and risk checks, and handles saving/downloading invoices with quota enforcement and authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceR: Modal dialog that displays deterministic risk analysis results for invoice compliance with German VAT law, showing critical issues and warnings.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout with header navigation tabs (Calculator, Invoices, Upgrade), login button, and analytics event logging for app opens and country detection.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Admin-only component for configuring Stripe integration by securely submitting secret key and allowed countries to the backend.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: Button component that initiates Stripe checkout session for plan upgrades, logs analytics events, and redirects to Stripe payment page.
frontend/src/components/usage/LimitReach: Modal dialog that appears when free plan invoice limit is reached, prompting users to upgrade with analytics tracking.
frontend/src/components/usage/UpgradeMod: Modal displaying Starter (€5/month) and Pro (€12/month) plan options with feature lists and upgrade navigation.
frontend/src/components/usage/UsageLimit: Alert banner showing remaining invoice count for free plan users (5 invoices per month limit).
frontend/src/components/vat/CountrySelec: Tabbed interface for selecting business country from EU or UK options, displaying country flags and VAT rates.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryTrans: Complex form for entering VAT transaction details including customer type, country, service category, amounts, and product categories with dynamic VAT rate calculation.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryVatDe: Displays country-specific VAT information including standard/reduced rates, features, and configuration status before proceeding to transaction entry.
frontend/src/components/vat/EuVatIntroSt: Initial country selection screen showing grid of EU countries with flags, VAT rates, and configuration status.
frontend/src/components/vat/ExplainVatPa: Displays VAT calculation explanations in two tabs (Standard and 'Explain like I'm 12'), with region-specific logic for UK vs Germany. Includes a Pro-gated PDF export feature with paywall dialog integration.
Modal dialog that prompts free users to upgrade to Pro for VAT explanation features, with analytics tracking and navigation to the upgrade page.
Visual stepper component showing progress through multi-step VAT calculation flow with numbered circles, checkmarks for completed steps, and connecting lines.
frontend/src/components/vat/GlobalDiscla: Displays a muted alert banner with disclaimer text stating that VAT rates vary and the tool provides estimates only, not legal or tax advice.
frontend/src/components/vat/ProductCateg: Grid-based button picker for selecting product categories, with visual selection state and support for exempt identifiers.
frontend/src/components/vat/ReverseCharg: Card component that validates B2B cross-border VAT reverse charge eligibility by checking VAT ID format and country match, displaying validation results with badges and analytics tracking.
frontend/src/components/vat/TransactionD: Multi-step form collecting transaction details including customer type (B2C/B2B), VAT ID, product category, VAT category, and net amount with validation and conditional field display.
frontend/src/components/vat/uk/UkSelectC: React component displaying UK VAT rates (20%, 5%, 0%) and registration threshold (£90,000) with a continue button to proceed to the next step.
frontend/src/components/vat/uk/UkTransac: Form component for UK VAT transaction input, handling transaction type, customer type, VAT category, net amount, and VAT ID with misuse warning detection and validation.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatCategoryI: Grid-based button picker for selecting VAT categories (standard, reduced, exempt) with visual selection indicators.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatResultsSt: Displays calculated VAT results with formatted currency amounts, classification badges, and educational notes explaining the VAT treatment based on scenario (reverse charge, exempt, export, etc.).
frontend/src/config/appMeta.ts: Centralized app metadata configuration defining display name 'Glotaxa', deployment slug, and description with validation for deployment slug constraints.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccountPlan.ts: React Query hook fetching user's account plan (free/starter/pro) and monthly invoice count from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook managing backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnonymousUsage.ts: Hook tracking anonymous user usage with daily fingerprint, enforcing a 5-usage free limit and providing increment functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Mutation hook creating Stripe checkout sessions via backend actor, validating session URLs and handling success/cancel redirects.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyFingerprint.t: Hook generating daily browser fingerprint from IP address and detecting user country for analytics and usage tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useEventLogger.ts: Hook providing event logging functionality with automatic fingerprint and country enrichment for analytics tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceNumberUniqu: Hook checking if an invoice number already exists in the backend to prevent duplicates.
Collection of hooks for invoice operations including listing, downloading PDFs, generating ZIP archives, and exporting to CSV/Excel formats.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceQuota.ts: Hook managing invoice saving with quota enforcement based on account plan (5 invoices/month for free tier) and invalidating related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanAccess.ts: Hook that retrieves the active account plan and returns boolean flags for paid, pro, and starter tiers.
Hook that detects the browser's preferred language on mount and returns the language code and an isEnglish flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching the current user profile and checking if Stripe is configured using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme colors, header styling, and z-index fixes for Radix UI dropdowns.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/coreEvents.ts: Defines immutable core event names as constants for analytics tracking (e.g., app_opened, vat_calculated, payment_success).
frontend/src/lib/analytics/countryDetect: Detects user country from IP address using the ipapi.co public API and returns country code and IP.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/eventLogger.t: Logs analytics events to the backend actor with metadata including event name, country, page, device type, and timestamp.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/fingerprint.t: Generates a daily GDPR-safe fingerprint by hashing IP, user agent, and date using SHA-256 with session caching.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/buildInvoiceHtm: Builds complete HTML invoice document from invoice data and VAT calculation results, including line items, totals, VAT breakdown, and optional German-to-English translation.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/currency.ts: Provides currency utilities including country-to-currency lookup via VAT table, currency formatting with Intl API, and currency symbol extraction.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/deriveInvoiceVa: Derives invoice VAT outcome (rate, amount, label, currency) from VAT calculation results, prioritizing cross-border treatment labels.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getAutoLegalVat: Auto-generates professional legal VAT text for invoices based on scenario and seller country, prioritizing cross-border treatment wording.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getInvoiceWordi: Returns country-specific professional invoice wording for VAT labels like Reverse Charge, Exempt, and Zero Rated.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/invoiceLineItem: Defines invoice line item data structures and provides calculation functions for line item totals, invoice totals, and VAT rate grouping.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/invoiceVatCateg: Provides functions to generate VAT category notes and warnings for invoice line items, including reduced rate warnings and special scenario notes (zero-rate, reverse-charge, vat-exempt).
Defines country-specific legal wording for reverse charge and VAT exempt scenarios across Germany, France, Italy, Netherlands, and UK, with fallback to generic EU VAT Directive text.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/riskCheck.ts: Performs comprehensive invoice risk checks including mandatory field validation, legal VAT text requirements, reverse charge proof validation, and date/format warnings.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/validateInvoice: Validates invoice compliance with VAT regulations, checking supplier/customer information, VAT number formats, country support, and generating blocking errors and warnings.
Validates mandatory invoice fields (supplier details, invoice number/date, line items, totals, legal VAT text) and returns a structured report of missing required fields.
frontend/src/lib/production/productionMa: Logs a production build version marker (v39) to the console in production mode for deployment verification purposes.
frontend/src/lib/translation/deToEn.ts: Provides deterministic offline German-to-English translation using a fixed dictionary of business and invoice terms, preserving capitalization and punctuation.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateUkVat.ts: Calculates UK VAT for various transaction types (goods export, EU services, domestic sales) applying zero-rating, reverse charge, or standard/reduced rates as appropriate.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateUnifiedVat: Smart VAT engine that determines cross-border VAT treatment (reverse-charge, export, intra-EU, domestic, EU B2C) based on country pairs and transaction type, then computes VAT amounts and returns a structured result with scenario, amounts in cents, and legal notes.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVat.ts: Defines VAT calculation input/output types and provides calculateEUVAT and calculateGermanyVAT functions that handle reverse charge, exemptions, effective rates, and various B2C/B2B scenarios with support for invoice details and UK-specific fields.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVatAmounts: Simple helper that calculates VAT amount and total from net amount and rate using the formula: vatAmount = netAmount * rate / 100; total = netAmount + vatAmount.
frontend/src/lib/vat/categoryEligibility: Defines exempt, UK zero-rated, UK reduced, and EU reduced product category lists (using snake_case identifiers) and provides eligibility check functions using normalized identifier matching to support both snake_case and kebab-case.
frontend/src/lib/vat/deriveVatRatePercen: Derives the VAT rate percentage for backend API calls from UI state (country, VAT category, selected reduced rate, reverse charge) using existing VAT helpers rather than hard-coded logic.
frontend/src/lib/vat/determineCrossBorde: Cross-border VAT treatment engine that determines treatment type (domestic, intra-EU supply, reverse-charge, export, EU B2C) based on seller/customer countries, customer type, supply type, and VAT ID; includes helper functions for mapping treatment to rates and invoice wording.
frontend/src/lib/vat/determineVatRate.ts: VAT rate decision engine implementing priority flow: reverse charge returns 0%, explicit reduced rate selection is used if provided, otherwise computes category-based rate from country config.
frontend/src/lib/vat/euCountryConfig.ts: Provides country configuration lookup functions with UK/GB normalization, wrapping vatTable entries; exports helper functions for EU countries, UK config, and a constant list of all supported country configs.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainUkVat.ts: Generates detailed UK-specific VAT explanations for different scenarios (domestic, export-zero, reverse-charge, exempt) including rate justifications and distinctions between zero-rated, exempt, and reverse charge treatments.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainVat.ts: Generates detailed human-readable explanations for German VAT calculation scenarios (Kleinunternehmer, reverse charge, exemptions, digital B2C, reduced rates) with legal references and practical implications.
Provides simplified, child-friendly explanations of VAT scenarios using plain language and analogies to make complex tax concepts accessible.
frontend/src/lib/vat/germanyVatRateHisto: Manages historical German VAT rates including COVID-19 temporary reductions, with functions to retrieve rates for specific dates and detect rate differences between invoice and current dates.
frontend/src/lib/vat/identifierNormaliza: Provides utility functions to normalize identifiers (lowercase, trim, convert underscores to hyphens) for consistent VAT/product category matching across different formats.
frontend/src/lib/vat/index.ts: Barrel export file that re-exports all VAT-related modules and types, with special handling to avoid SupplyType conflicts from determineCrossBorderVAT.
frontend/src/lib/vat/isZeroVatResult.ts: Helper function to identify VAT calculation results that indicate 0% VAT scenarios (UK export zero-rated or explicit 0% rate) for UI locking behavior.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ossIndicator.ts: Checks if One-Stop-Shop (OSS) registration is relevant for cross-border digital/SaaS B2C sales within the EU and provides explanatory reasons.
frontend/src/lib/vat/productCategoryOpti: Defines product category dropdown options for VAT calculations with labels, internal values, UK-specific flags, and country-based filtering logic.
frontend/src/lib/vat/promptFlowGermany.t: Contains system prompts and multi-screen flow prompts for a conversational VAT calculation engine covering German VAT rules, invoice generation, explanations, and upgrade flows.
Validates product category eligibility for reduced VAT rates per country (EU common categories, UK 5% and 0% rates) and returns appropriate reduced rates or eligibility messages.
frontend/src/lib/vat/region.ts: Defines region types (EU, UK, USA, APAC), provides country code normalization (UK→GB), region detection from country codes, and support status checks.
frontend/src/lib/vat/selectedSellerCount: Helper functions to safely read, validate, and set seller country codes in URL search parameters with format validation and defensive null checks.
frontend/src/lib/vat/toBackendVatCalcula: Maps frontend calculator form state to backend VatCalculation payload, validating required fields and converting category names to backend enum format.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ukMisuseWarnings.ts: Checks for UK VAT misuse patterns (e.g., reduced rate for consulting, zero rate for software) and returns appropriate warnings with modal flags.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ukTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript types for UK-specific VAT calculations including transaction types, customer types, VAT categories, and result structures.
frontend/src/lib/vat/validateReverseChar: Validates reverse charge eligibility for B2B cross-border transactions by checking VAT ID format and verifying the country prefix matches the customer country.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatCategoryRateRule: Defines VAT categories and computes country-specific VAT rates based on category eligibility rules for DE, FR, IT, SE, BE, ES, and GB.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatConfig.ts: Provides a simple configuration object mapping country codes to standard, reduced, and zero VAT rates for supported countries.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatResultBuilder.ts: Utility function to build canonical VAT result objects containing rate, VAT amount, total, and label from net amount and rate.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatTable.ts: Central VAT configuration table mapping country codes to detailed VAT information including rates, currency, flags, and invoice labels with aliased properties.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/CalculatorFlowPage.ts: Multi-step VAT calculator flow managing country selection, transaction details, results display, explanation, invoice details, and preview with navigation between steps.
frontend/src/pages/InvoicesPage.tsx: Invoice management page with list view, batch selection, PDF downloads, ZIP exports for batches/months, and CSV/Excel export with plan-based access control.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page component that displays features, EU and UK country selection cards, and navigates to the calculator with selected country code as a search parameter.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Payment failure page that displays an error message with options to retry payment or return to home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Payment success page that logs payment success event, invalidates account plan cache, and provides navigation to calculator or invoices.
frontend/src/pages/UpgradePage.tsx: Upgrade page displaying Free, Starter, and Pro pricing plans with Stripe checkout integration and admin setup component for unconfigured payment systems.
frontend/src/utils/downloadFile.ts: Utility function that creates and triggers browser downloads for both text (CSV) and binary (PDF, ZIP, Excel) content using Blob URLs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter utilities for extracting, persisting, and clearing parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, extended theme properties, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite configuration with React plugin, environment variable handling for canisters, path aliases, and development server proxy setup for API calls.
project_state.json: Project state tracking a fix request for a 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toString)' error occurring during country selection in the VAT calculator.
